==Description==
The '''Spring Frenzy Battle Pass''' was the seventeenth pass to be added to the game. It is the spring-themed battlepass along with the rerun of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]].

The [[Ducky Revenge Event]] rerun ended on the 5th of June 2026, while the '''Spring Frenzy Battle Pass''' ended on the 11th of June 2026.

==Battle Pass==
[[File:SpringFrenzyPass.png|center|450px]]
'''Spring Frenzy Battle Pass''' used {{Bunz|Bunz}} as its currency, which were collected from enemies. These enemies dropped between one and three currency on death, which were collected by walking near them. These currency drops did not give one {{Bunz|Bunz}} each. The number varied based on the mode played, and it could be boosted by the [[Battlepass Boost]] modifier, which was occasionally enabled by the developers. It boosted the rewards by 50%.

In total, it took {{Bunz|27,080}} to complete the battle pass. The battle pass had two tracks, the regular track could have been obtained for free and the premium track was purchasable for {{Robux|399}}.

Certain items like [[High Grade Crate]]s were given out multiple times. In total, the '''Spring Frenzy Battle Pass''' gave out {{Coins|4,000}}, {{Exp|2,700}}, {{TimeScaleTicket|8}}, 15 [[Easter Egg]]s, 6 [[High Grade Crate]]s, 3 [[Premium Crate]]s, {{SpinTicket|14}}, 12 [[Ducky Squad]]s, 4 [[Holy Hand Grenade]]s, 4 [[Nuke]]s and 5 [[Molten Monster (Consumable)|Molten Monsters]].

===Triumphs===
Included in the '''Spring Frenzy Battle Pass''' as part of a [[Ducky Revenge Event]] rerun. To unlock the following skin, the player needed to triumph [[Bathroom Approach]] on the Hard difficulty three times. The second triumph had to be done 64 hours after the first one, while the third one had to be done 64 hours after the second triumph had been done. It could also been bought for {{Robux|399}} to unlock it early.
